Record Class ShopDetailResult

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.dianping.shop.shopdetail.model.result.ShopDetailResult
Record Components:
shop - 店铺基础资料
vouchers - 优惠券读取结果
setmeals - 套餐读取结果
recommendations - 推荐菜读取结果
reviews - 评价读取结果
statistics - 全店评价统计响应
blogs - 关联当前店铺的探店笔记
decisionTags - 评价与博客合并得到的近期口碑标签
reviewTags - 仅由近期评价得到的高频标签
relatedShops - 同类型周边店铺
recommendationStateAvailable - 当前用户的推荐状态是否读取成功
public record ShopDetailResult(ShopDetailResult.BaseInfo shop, SectionResult<ShopPageResult<ShopDetailResult.VoucherItem>> vouchers, SectionResult<ShopPageResult<ShopSetmealResult>> setmeals, SectionResult<ShopPageResult<RecommendDishItem>> recommendations, SectionResult<ShopPageResult<ShopReviewItem>> reviews, SectionResult<ShopDetailResult.ReviewStatistics> statistics, SectionResult<ShopPageResult<ShopDetailResult.BlogItem>> blogs, SectionResult<java.util.List<ShopDetailResult.TagItem>> decisionTags, SectionResult<java.util.List<ShopDetailResult.TagItem>> reviewTags, SectionResult<ShopPageResult<ShopDetailResult.RelatedItem>> relatedShops, boolean recommendationStateAvailable) extends java.lang.Record
商详应用响应；领域组合与引擎诊断不直接作为 HTTP 返回类型。
